thread:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout release v0.12.7 -> 10% (us-west-2). Changes: quantized-kernel routing + batch_window=8ms. CI: green. Rolling now.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p95 latency spike for /v1/generate (canary). p95 ~120ms -> ~950ms; error rate 5xx up ~0.8%. Grafana: https://grafana.company/shared/canary-latency

oncall-alex: I'm on it, joining. @sre-rachel @eng-lee please grab.

sre-rachel: Looking at canary nodes: kernel fallback spam in logs and CPU at 95%. Batch queues growing (microbatch wait times increasing).

eng-lee: I pushed the quant-route optimization earlier (kernel selector prefers quant kernels). Could be that for certain op patterns it falls back to slower path. Also the reduced batch_window might be increasing small-batch frequency.

oncall-alex: Can we gate it with the feature flag while we triage? Suggest: flip canary.quant_route -> false.

eng-lee: Running the flag flip now:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api/feature_flags/canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"quant_route": false}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated for canary: quant_route = false. Holding traffic at 10%.

incident-bot: Metrics update: p95 fell to ~260ms after flag flip, error rate down but a handful of 5xx remain (~0.2%). Trending down.

oncall-alex: Good improvement but still seeing residual 5xx and some pods stuck in draining state. Plan: abort canary -> drain traffic to 0% and fully rollback the release until root cause confirmed. Any objections?

eng-lee: No objections. Initiating canary abort: `/deploy abort --release v0.12.7 --scope canary` (kickoff id: abort-1765432165).

deploy-bot: Canary abort accepted. Draining traffic; nodes will be removed from load balancer and replaced with previous stable.

customer-john_doe: We're seeing 502s from the API around ~11:22 UTC, some customers affected. Can you confirm impact/rollback status?

ops-jia: Support: Confirmed customer request failures correlate with canary window in us-west-2. About ~12 distinct clients saw transient 502/504s. Logging extraction underway.

sre-rachel: From logs: repeated entries: `__quant_kernel_fallback__ - op=matmul, seq_len=1024 -> using scalar fallback; latency penalty ~x8`. This fallback path also serializes some KV cache ops, hurting batching. Snippet: 
```
[2024-08-17 11:21:43] WARN kernel_selector: quant_kernel_fallback triggered for model=redwood-small seq=1024 node=canary-3; fallback_stack=...
[2024-08-17 11:21:44] ERROR serve: request=abcd-1234 -> 502 upstream timeout after 1200ms
```

eng-lee: Root cause hypothesis: selector incorrectly prefers quant kernels for certain patterns; driver-level corner-case triggers fallback to slower path which both increases per-token latency and reduces effective batching. Fix path: add a selector safety check and revert the quant-route change in canary. We'll also add sequence-length hist to canary dashboards.

oncall-alex: Rollback progress?

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary traffic = 0% as of 1765432178. Stable traffic served by v0.12.6.

pm-aaron: Do we have copy for customers? Need short blurb: explain transient 5xx during canary rollout in us-west-2; rollback performed; investigating root cause; will follow up with postmortem.

eng-lee: Draft blurb: "We briefly observed increased latency and transient 5xx errors in us-west-2 during a canary rollout for a performance optimization. We rolled the canary back and are investigating a kernel selection edge-case that caused a slow fallback path. No persistent customer data loss. Postmortem to follow."

ops-jia: CS will push that after legal check; tracking INC-2024-0817.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2024-0817 (P2) — owner: eng-lee. Pagerlog and actions recorded.

oncall-alex: Handoff notes for daytime oncall (@sre-rachel): - rollback complete; monitoring stable but watch p95 and 5xx in us-west-2 for 1hr - engage eng-lee for follow ups - postmortem owner assigned. If errors resurface, page severity escalation.

sre-rachel: ACK. I'll take primary oncall for next 30m and follow-up with eng to schedule a canary retest with additional telemetry.

oncall-alex: Closing channel for now. Reopen if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:

eng-lee: Action items (short): 1) revert quant-route on main branch + tag, 2) add sequence length histogram + kernel-fallback counter to canary dashboard, 3) add FF gating for kernel selection, 4) run a controlled canary with synthetic sequences. Owner: eng-lee.

ops-jia: Support will notify impacted customers with the blurb and will link to incident page.

pm-aaron: Thanks all — please add timeline & hypothesis to INC ticket.
